topic: Day 140 — reel — People around you resist your change longer than you resist it yourself
text:
They're not
doubting you.
They're
[catching] up.
caption:
The people around you had an investment in the old version. That friction is their catch-up time, not a verdict on whether it's real.

Follow for one of these a day.
